Package com.goodbird.npcgecko.api

Interface IGeckoItemModel

  • public interface IGeckoItemModel
    Interface for accessing and modifying GeckoLib 3D model configuration on items. Provides control over model, texture, animation files, display transforms, and display JSON settings for Scripted and Linked items.

    Changes made through this interface are automatically persisted to the ItemStack's NBT and synced to clients via container mechanics.

    Obtain an instance via AbstractGeckoAPI.getItemGecko(noppes.npcs.api.item.IItemCustomizable).

    Usage example:

     var itemGecko = gecko.getItemGecko(event.item);
 itemGecko.setModel("geckolib3:geo/sword.geo.json");
 itemGecko.setTexture("geckolib3:textures/model/sword.png");
 itemGecko.setAnimationFile("geckolib3:animations/sword.animation.json");
 itemGecko.setIdleAnimation("animation.sword.idle");
    See Also:
    AbstractGeckoAPI.getItemGecko(noppes.npcs.api.item.IItemCustomizable)

      • setDisplayJSON

        void setDisplayJSON​(String displayFile)
        Set the display JSON file for controlling how the 3D model is positioned, rotated, and scaled in each render context (first person, third person, inventory, and ground).

        Display files are loaded from assets/{domain}/item_displays/ resource folders. Use AbstractGeckoAPI.getDisplayFileList() to list available files.

        Parameters:
        displayFile - the display JSON filename (e.g. "sword.json")
        See Also:
        AbstractGeckoAPI.getDisplayFileList()

      • setDisplay

        void setDisplay​(String context,
                float tx,
                float ty,
                float tz,
                float rx,
                float ry,
                float rz,
                float sx,
                float sy,
                float sz)
        Set the display transform for a specific render context. This overrides any display JSON settings for the specified context and controls how the 3D model is positioned, rotated, and scaled.

        Valid context values:

        • "first_person" - held item in first-person view
        • "third_person" - held item in third-person view
        • "inventory" - item icon in inventory GUI
        • "ground" - dropped item entity on the ground
        Parameters:
        context - the render context name
        tx - translation X offset
        ty - translation Y offset
        tz - translation Z offset
        rx - rotation X in degrees
        ry - rotation Y in degrees
        rz - rotation Z in degrees
        sx - scale X multiplier
        sy - scale Y multiplier
        sz - scale Z multiplier
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the context name is not recognized

      • clear

        void clear()
        Remove the gecko model from this item, reverting it to normal 2D rendering. Clears all model, texture, animation, and display settings.
